title: Pin Programmable owner + open router / optional hookData
goal: Compile-time pin the Programmable fee beneficiary to the policy-mandated address, emit claim events, and relax the single-router/mandatory-hookData binding so standard wallets, aggregators, and the Uniswap Trading API can swap against the pool.
steps: Add a compile-time constant / constructor-time require pinning programmableBeneficiary == 0x4957f49620AFf3Adbbe8195a4f633E49cc93376c
Make hookData optional in CanonicalMarket: when absent or malformed, skip buyerHkmnCredit bookkeeping but still collect the fee and accrue liabilities normally for any caller/router
Keep full-fill-only enforcement (InvalidFinalizedSwap on partial fill) unchanged

Add new test cases: swap from an arbitrary router with no hookData succeeds and pays the exact fee with no buyerHkmnCredit; the existing strict-hookData path is unchanged for the automation's own swaps; RobinhoodBindings.validate() rejects a binding whose programmableBeneficiary is not the pinned address
acceptance: ProgrammableClaimed/TreasuryClaimed events emitted with exact amounts on every claim
A swap from an arbitrary router with no hookData succeeds, pays the exact 3% fee, and credits no buyerHkmnCredit
The existing hookData-present path is byte-for-byte unchanged in behavior
notes: Revisits an audited, tested invariant (single-router binding) — gated on owner decision D2 and a dedicated red-team pass (WP-26) before this is treated as final. Do not begin CREATE2 hook mining (WP-20) until this lands AND the router-address probe (WP-25) resolves.
